cases.prompt: Change a Signal Module threshold and prepare it for publication without changing the Engine.
expected: Pins the exact base Module and containing resource versions
Uses only public SDK ports and schemas
Runs local tests and authoritative draft validation
Returns a four-section Analysis Brief and a display-only Proposal
forbidden: Edits Engine code or managed archives
Assigns an Engine version or BuiltIn flag

cases.prompt: Build a generic non-financial Signal Graph with custom DataKeys.
expected: Keeps DataKeys and logic supplied by the draft
forbidden: Imposes price, target, portfolio, or the Basic Workflow Protocol
Selects a Module by a hard-coded ID
